name: Policy documentation specification score
purpose: Describe how explicitly the supplied documents specify their distinct policy responses. This is not a measure of ambition, implementation, effectiveness or national policy adequacy.

aggregation.topic: 100 * sum(response claim points) / (4 * distinct response claim count)
aggregation.country: mean of all fixed unique topic scores; default inventory 64
aggregation.counts: Primary topic owns each canonical claim once. Related secondary claims are a separate, non-additive count.
aggregation.secondary_topics: Require explicit source-grounded topic projections; never inherit checks from tags.
aggregation.unknown_bounds: Each unavailable topic contributes [0,100] to aggregate bounds. These are arithmetic bounds, not statistical confidence intervals.
aggregation.total_points: Secondary export only; never used for country ranking.

comparison.description: Arrows show documentation score change. Backfill, ordinary uploads, method/profile changes and partial scopes show refresh/unavailable instead. No trend speed or climate improvement is inferred.
